sloka: अब्रवीत् स महात्मनः सर्वान् एव कृतांजलिः ।शरणम् वः प्रपद्ये अहम् शरण्यान् शरणागतः ॥१-५७-१७॥
transliteration: abravīt sa mahātmanaḥ sarvān eva kṛtāṁjaliḥ ।śaraṇam vaḥ prapadye aham śaraṇyān śaraṇāgataḥ ॥1-57-17॥

translations.english: "Rejected by my guru and his sons, what I achieved was disaster and what I could not was the fulfilment of my wish.
